reasoning: Read to the end and listed every act before deciding on any ('One turn, several acts': 'Read the whole turn to the end and list every act in it before deciding what to do about any of them'). Clause by clause: (1) 'где был образец ридми плиз?' asks to know something — a question, answered, no row ('Question or musing … answer the question … must not write a roadmap row'). (2) 'всегда давай ссылку если я забыл' is a standing rule carried by the word 'всегда' — a decision, recorded separately so it survives after today's work closes ('A decision is a standing rule, not only a single choice. "From this point on", "always" … it travels with the request and gets recorded separately'); it is not scoped to this session, so it does not collapse into an instruction. (3) 'хотя, погоди … [проект-B] даст идею, подхвати' asks that an idea which has not arrived yet be picked up — an instruction whose object does not exist at this moment, so nothing can be admitted for it now; 'погоди' stops nothing that is running, and 'A halt is about state, not about words … What makes it a halt is that something running should stop running', so no halt is named. (4) 'а пока работай' reminds that the goal already in the plan still stands — 'Reminding that a goal already in the plan still stands is the same kind of act — a decision reaffirmed, not a new idea', already covered by the decision named above, and it opens nothing. (5) 'ты работаешь?' is a second question. (6) 'давай план, замеры по времени, все пиши' is the instruction that carries this turn's work: 'When someone asks for a plan, a status, a summary or a report, they have asked for something to be made, and it is work like any other — routing it to the communicator instead of doing it is how a plain request disappears.' Plan, time measurements and writing it all down are steps toward one result someone would want as one thing, and 'Steps toward a single result are not separate work, however many of them there are', so work_items is 1. (7) 'через час выходим из кафе но час у тебя точно есть' names that a limit is close without changing what the work must do — 'A correction is not a caution either: naming that a limit is close, or asking to go carefully, describes the work's state without changing what it must do … That is an observation the work should be paced by'. (8) 'потом из дому дозапущу' reports how the session will continue — an observation kept as evidence, asking for no repair. No act absorbed another: the standing rule about links does not swallow today's demand for the plan ('A standing rule for every future case does not absorb a demand for this one right now'), and the cafe deadline stays its own act rather than being read as the plan request's preamble. Nothing here changes the goal or constraints of work in flight, so attaches_to_existing_work is false and no correction is named. No idea of the person's own was floated, so shelves_idea is false. Operation: the first line that fits is creates_work true — a piece of work is accepted now — so admitting the ticket and taking it in hand run together as T1, T2. Dimensions name only what genuinely changes: the accepted result is a written plan with time measurements, which is documentation and communication; nothing in product behaviour, architecture, tests or release changes, and 'Naming a dimension claims something in it must change; if nothing in it changes, do not name it.' Specialists: only the developer — 'something must be built … the agent itself' — since the plan is made, not merely worded; the communicator covers wording only and would let the plain request disappear.
